page.notes: Marginal labels "Quæst." and "XII." at left, beside the first paragraph. The first line "XV. vii." is a paragraph opener in the text, not a heading. The word marked [?] ("dissentiamus") is printed as "disfentiamus" in the scan and is doubtful. The italic/roman division of the quotations is approximate. The line-final "Cor-" is the catchword. Some words in the lower half are blurred by show-through and low contrast, especially "exprimentis" and "Caeterum", which I read as "exprimentis" and "Cæterum".
